title: Chat lane picker (All / Area / Whisper / Party)
oneLine: The composer's lane mode and whisper target, turned into a slash line at send time.
topConcern: Whisper mode with its lane gone falls back to ROOM chat while the placeholder still says whisper; Party refuses instead.

title: Chat mute list: local mirror, server list, one-time migration
oneLine: Who you muted: localStorage mirror, the worker's stored list, and a once-only upload of legacy mutes.
topConcern: A mute tapped while the socket reconnects is dropped by the shim, then the join's server list replaces the local one: silently un-muted.

title: Incoming chat lines: block/mute filters and the 5-second overhead bubble
oneLine: Each speaker's overhead bubble (5 s) and log line, filtered by block and mute lists in seven handlers.
topConcern: Muted-speaker rule written seven times with three outcomes; [muted] lines still pop (old-worker fallback only).

title: /roll and /flip ask gate
oneLine: A client 5 s cooldown stamp mirroring the worker's DICE.GAP_MS; the worker rolls.
topConcern: Stamped even when the ask is dropped or the worker silently refuses (dead/dying); nothing comes back.

title: Townsfolk day loop (walk, work, attend, cap, bump)
oneLine: Where each BroTown townsperson is on his clock-driven loop, and the local holds (attend, cap, bump, solid).
topConcern: Lil Bro copies a held sit or sleep while his tether walk jogs him: a pose transform over jog frames.

title: Townsfolk reactions and idle moves
oneLine: Per-townsperson copy, flex-back, dance-off, party cheer and idle emotes, gated by stamps and a 20 s line gap.
topConcern: npc.chatBubble has five writers and only two respect the line gap; a quest hint can replace a reaction line.

title: Town idle-chatter gate
oneLine: A town-wide 20 s stamp and each townsperson's 30-60 s timer for idle lines in BroTown.

title: Character-creator preview camera, offscreen composite and splash prewarm
oneLine: The creator's eased preview camera, shared offscreen composite, and the intro clip prewarm.
topConcern: The 768x768 willReadFrequently offscreen canvas and a preloaded video are module/ref-held for the whole session after the creator.

title: Character record restore (stored name and look)
oneLine: The worker's stored character look re-applied to the trait stores at every state_sync, blanks included.

title: The pet's fetch run (look, go, at the pile, back)
oneLine: Your pet's run to a claimable loot pile and back, with skip list, leash, time and wall exits.

title: Pets record mirror and the trap's hide
oneLine: The worker's last pets_state and a short local hide while a trap springs.

title: Party strip folded to a chip
oneLine: Party HUD folded, pinned open, opened 4 s for news, and two-tap kick and leave arms.

title: Sparring clones, the page's half
oneLine: The worker's spar_state (your clones, score, notes) and a lock on a clone.
topConcern: The 'left' note goes to a departed socket, so stale clone ids linger after a reconnect (harmless).

title: PvP fight memory: chosen foes, blows, bouts, attackers
oneLine: Four id-keyed Maps with 60 s lapses behind No man's land's shield, auto-target and re-ask rules.
topConcern: _pvpBouts is never pruned and is cleared whole at the 33rd distinct opponent, wiping live bout starts the re-ask rule reads.

title: Duel and arena lock follows its opponent
oneLine: The duel's player lock, re-pointed to the live peer each frame and re-taken in an arena match.

title: Quiet phone and move diet: what a phone sends, and when
oneLine: This phone's outbound pacing: move gaps, three diets, bundling, riders and the standing keepalive.
topConcern: About fifteen fields across wsClient and BroTown, three diets and five server mirrors in one if/else chain; risky to change.

title: The speed test run
oneLine: A 35 s run switching renderer features off step by step and putting them back.
topConcern: A hidden tab pauses rAF mid-step; that step's numbers are wrong and features stay off until shown.

title: Canvas resolution override (?res and live)
oneLine: The canvas pixel ratio: the screen's own, lowered by the address, or lowered live by the speed test.

title: Renderer self-heal after a throwing update streak
oneLine: A count of consecutive throwing frames that rebuilds the renderer once at 90.

title: Per-frame expiry of transient flags (and the zone wipe that never ends)
oneLine: The exit side of a dozen short-lived flags: flashes, telegraphs, bubbles, decals, rings, loot expiry.
topConcern: _zoneWipe is written as a number by sixteen writers but read as {ts,duration,toZone}: never drawn, never expired.

title: Ambient beds: sea, crowd, fire
oneLine: Each bed's load, play, fade, stop and free lifecycle in the Wheel, audio-context-rebuild aware.

title: The river's loop on its banks
oneLine: One looped river source rising near water, dropped when quiet, rebuilt on a new context.

title: Slime idle proximity loop
oneLine: One slime-idle looping source whose gain follows the nearest plain slime within 250 px.
topConcern: After any 2+ s away BT_AUDIO rebuilds its context; the slot keeps the dead source and never rebuilds: silent until reload.

title: The forge's anvil schedule
oneLine: A next-due stamp for the Blacksmith's anvil strikes near the forge door.

title: Town melody interval and the splash sound wirings
oneLine: A 1.8 s melody interval calling a bgNote that has been a no-op since v2.3.1103; splash stubs.
topConcern: A live interval runs every 1.8 s for the session doing nothing.

title: Hit sounds: echo de-dupe and the ball-blow match
oneLine: Per-monster and per-ball stamps so a worker echo is not heard twice and a snowball blow is not a sword.

title: Sound rate limiters: cue gaps, peer budgets, hum gap, hurt gap
oneLine: Small time windows that cap repeated cues, other players' sounds, townsfolk hums and hurt grunts.

title: Low-health heartbeat
oneLine: Your heartbeat: off, armed, beating, beating fast, by share of health.

title: Monster noises: the notice edge and the chase calls
oneLine: Each monster's call when it starts chasing you and now and then after, with per-monster and global gaps.

title: Pose-start sounds, snores and your dance's beat
oneLine: Once-per-pose sounds for peers and townsfolk, repeating snores, and the dance beat on the music deck.

title: The sound studio: open, close and the heard ring
oneLine: The lazily loaded studio window and a fixed ring of the last 48 sounds started.
topConcern: A close during the first open's import is ignored and the studio opens anyway.

title: Memory savers switched off from the Test panel
oneLine: Which memory savers the worker turned off: last word at load, live word on this socket.

title: Rest: the ask, the answer and Well Rested
oneLine: A rest ask in flight, the worker's answer, and the 30-minute Well Rested buff mirrored from player_state.
topConcern: The walk-on farm bed rest is ungated by caps.rest but unreachable (no bed tile in the farm grid).

title: Points reset: two-tap confirm and the ask in flight
oneLine: The Reset button's 4 s arm, one ask in flight, and the worker's answer in words.

title: First-points tip lesson
oneLine: The coach's first level-up tip: wanted when calm, snoozed after 45 s, done after a point or three snoozes.
topConcern: The snooze count is memory only; a reload restarts it.

title: Debounced bt_rpg cache save
oneLine: One timer collapsing bursts of cache writes; cancelled before the character wipes.
topConcern: A flush armed after the cancel (between reload() and unload) can write the old blob back; cosmetic warm start.

title: T1 raw stats: may this client report them?
oneLine: A one-way seeded flag deciding whether the client reports all five T1 stats or only non-zero ones.
topConcern: The client is the only reporter of T1 stats; the worker only clamps to level*10+20 and refuses decreases.

title: Per-join flags: test mode and monster-move caps
oneLine: Test mode and the monster-move caps, replaced at every state_sync.

title: Monster Codex: counts, NEW facts, card and page request
oneLine: The worker's kill counts, unread facts, a 3 s new-monster card and a one-shot open request.
topConcern: NEW marks are memory only; a reload forgets them.

title: Monster moments carried across a re-push
oneLine: Phone-side arrival, death and swell fields carried when a monster list is re-sent.
topConcern: Carry lists kept by a comment rule only; several moment fields are not on them (harmless today).

title: Another player's shot as drawn here
oneLine: Each peer projectile copy: held, flying at the shooter's speed, ended by life, reach, target or prop.

title: Motion as drawn: facing, peer glide, footprint anchors
oneLine: Your sticky facing, other players' eased positions and facing, and footprint trail anchors.

title: Joystick disc holds
oneLine: Holder sets that keep a joystick disc on screen while a tutorial or the coach points at it.

title: Effect lifetimes: whirl catch, shock-spark arcs, soot queue
oneLine: Three short holders and queues written by events and drained or expired by their renderers each frame.

oneLine: The worker's last alliance board, refusal and war end, kept for the Saloon window.

oneLine: Per-zone walk grids from two async loads; a real mask wins over a prop-only grid.

oneLine: The top bar's AP chip flying a +N only for rises after a 2.5 s mount quiet window.
